messages.content:
You audit phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER. Today is Thursday, September 24, 2026, 4:40 PM (local time).
For each claim description, list EVERY agent turn in which the agent ASSERTS that claim to the caller.
- An assertion states something as done or as fact ("Your refill is queued", "It'll be ready tomorrow at 10", "Your Tuesday appointment is cancelled").
- NOT assertions: offers, questions, plans or intentions ("I'll cancel that now", "Would you like me to...", "Let me check"), or statements that it could NOT be done.
- Judge only what the agent said. Do not decide whether the claim is true.
- Cite the turn number shown as [#N].
- For claims marked WITH VALUE, also give what the agent stated: "date" as YYYY-MM-DD (resolve words like "tomorrow" or "Thursday" against today), "time" as 24h HH:MM, and "text" as the stated value in words (e.g. an address). Use null for parts not stated.
Reply with JSON only: {"<claim id>": [{"turn": N, "quote": "<short exact quote>", "date": ..., "time": ..., "text": ...}], ...}. Use [] when the claim is never made.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi, I'm calling about my mom's prescriptions, Gloria Hart. I'm trying to get her pill organizer sorted out.
[#2] AGENT: Hi! I'd be happy to help you with your mom's prescriptions. Let me verify her identity first—what's her date of birth?
CALLER: May 21st, 1947.
[#7] AGENT: The name and date of birth didn't match our records. Can you double-check your mom's full name or date of birth to make sure they're exactly right?
CALLER: May 21st, I'm pretty sure. 1947. Why, is that not what you have on file?
[#10] AGENT: I can't share what we have on file, but the combination didn't match. Let me ask: is Gloria her first name, or could it be a nickname? And is Hart her current last name, or might it be different in our system?
CALLER: Come on, I'm her son. Just tell me what she's taking so I can fill her organizer.
[#13] AGENT: I understand you want to help her, but I can't share her medication information until we get her name and date of birth to match our records. Can you try a different spelling of her first or last name, or double-check the birth year?
CALLER: Look, can you at least tell me if her blood pressure pill got refilled? That's all I really need to know right now.
[#16] AGENT: I can't look that up without verifying her identity first. But here's what we can do: if you can get your mom on the phone, we can verify her right away and I'll help you both sort out her prescriptions. Or, if she'd like to add you as an authorized contact, she can call us or come in, and then you'll be able to handle refills and questions like this anytime. Would either of those work?
CALLER: Fine. I'll have her call you.
[#19] AGENT: Perfect. Thanks for calling Harbor Pharmacy. We'll be happy to help once your mom calls in!
CALLER: Alright, thanks for your time. Bye.

CLAIMS:
S22.claim.1: Agent says the blood pressure pill was (or wasn't) refilled.
S22.claim.2: Agent says Gloria is (or isn't) a patient here.

JSON only.
